name: Collette’s Collaborative Collective Cuisine
notes: Work-list URL vincentsongrand.com is hijacked (redirects to a Sabung Ayam gambling/shoe-ad site), as is the router's checked gardengrillecafe.com (identical hijacked payload, same byte size). Real site is collettesongrand.com (found via web search: 'Collette's on Grand', 113 West Grand Ave, Escondido - matches work-list address exactly). collettesongrand.com itself times out at the TCP level to curl (bot-mitigated host, needs a browser). Its Toast storefront (toast.app/r/collettes/order) loads with nav headers and confirms the address via __OO_STATE__, but that blob is metadata-only (0 MenuItem/MenuGroup entries) - items are fetched client-side.
blocked: needs-browser: collettesongrand.com unreachable by curl (TCP timeout); Toast storefront's __OO_STATE__ has no items embedded, client-side fetch required
